verdict.rationale: Docs confirm PTO policy setup with policy name/type, start/end dates, and timecard sync integrated into the Time Off module, and payroll accuracy checks reference employee profile data. However, evidence lacks detail on accrual rules configuration and explicit approval workflows tied automatically into payroll processing. missing for 10: explicit accrual rate/rollover configuration, approval workflow documentation, and confirmation that approved PTO auto-feeds into payroll runs.
